name: gamesmith
description: Game-dev skills for AI coding agents that run real scripts against your project: Blender, Godot, Unity, Unreal and engine-agnostic craft.

plugins.name: gamesmith-core
plugins.description: Engine-agnostic skills: repo setup with Git LFS, game feel, performance budgets.

plugins.name: gamesmith-blender
plugins.description: Blender skills: game-readiness scene audit and one-command export to Godot, Unity or Unreal.

plugins.name: gamesmith-godot
plugins.description: Godot 4 skills: idiomatic GDScript, a project linter (Godot 3 leftovers, broken res:// paths) and headless CI.

plugins.name: gamesmith-unity
plugins.description: Unity skills: .meta/GUID hygiene checker and batchmode tests and builds.

plugins.name: gamesmith-unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5 skills: C++ gameplay conventions and a project hygiene checker.
